name: COMP_004
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (65%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Image reliability is flagged and the conformal set has three classes; invasive probability is only 5%.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 65%, InSitu 19%, Benign 10%, Invasive 5% | Clear lead, low invasive |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, InSitu | Three classes not separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.38 (flagged); OOD 88th percentile | Input itself suspect [F6] |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Neighbors support suggestion [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Score below typical, so it lowers invasive association [F4] · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical, but spot check failed (0/20) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 4, 5) · ↑ invasive · Mildly raises invasive association; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules and mitoses are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Reliability is 0.38 with OOD at the 88th percentile; probabilities may be miscalibrated.
- Region 5 carries the highest invasive contribution; a focal lesion may be diluted.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 5**: highest invasive contribution; look for infiltrating tumor, necrosis, mitoses.
2. **Region 9**: check for atypical cells confined within ducts; in situ is in the set.
3. **Regions 3, 7, 11**: confirm two-layered lobular epithelium; this concept failed its spot check.
